items.title: Marqeta's Anthony Peculic Wants the Card to Choose For You
items.why: Card-issuing infrastructure players like Marqeta could power embedded smart-card features for future issuer partners.
items.summary_ai: Marqeta executive Anthony Peculic discusses cards that make spending choices on the user's behalf.
items.take: Card-issuing infrastructure players like Marqeta could power embedded smart-card features for future issuer partners.
